rc=2, REFUSED, nothing written -- the correct outcome for an apply with no Lambda code in it. The resolver was read before it was trusted: record-deploy-scope.py applied_addresses() admits an address only when its change.actions intersect {create, update}, and terraform show -json of this plan carries module.cot_rebalancer_runner.aws_lambda_function.this with actions=no-op, so the resolved set is empty and the script fails closed. A first attempt failed differently and is recorded for the next reader: passing --plan with a path already relative to the repo root makes the scope tool resolve it under the terraform directory a second time (path doubling) and terraform show reports 'Failed to read the given file as a state or plan file'; the plan name must be relative to the terraform root.
